title: CorpusIndex
description: scrapes/INDEX.json: every corpus CAPTURE.WebScraper holds, keyed by its folder under scrapes/. Consumers (OS/system/pipeline.json, LIB.NCP) find a corpus by key here rather than by a hard-coded folder path; the folder can then move with one edit to this file. Written by apk_webscraper.engine.update_index on every run.

source_url.description: The base URL the crawl was scoped to.

html.description: Folder under scrapes/ holding the fetched pages (with .provenance.json sidecars).

markdown.description: Folder under scrapes/ holding the Markdown derivatives.

last_run.description: UTC, Z-suffixed; null when unknown (corpus predates the index).

tool.description: fetcher name and version, as in the manifests' `fetcher`.
